lessons.title: Future plans with going to
objectives: State a personal plan and give one reason for it.
Use a main idea and one relevant detail in a response about planning a study evening.

content_sections.title: Notice form and meaning (8 minutes)
content_sections.body: Read the model aloud twice: 'I am going to revise vocabulary after dinner and practise speaking on Friday.' Underline the words that show the situation, time, or result. In this lesson, state a personal plan and give one reason for it. Keep the language connected: do not give isolated words.

content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)
content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about planning a study evening. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: State a personal plan and give one reason for it.

content_sections.title: Independent response (6 minutes)
content_sections.body: Create a short message about planning a study evening without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.

exercises.prompt: Choose the response that gives a clear, useful message for this situation: planning a study evening.
options: I am going to revise vocabulary after dinner and practise speaking on Friday.
Could we move the meeting to Tuesday because I have a class on Monday?
I can make an arrangement, respond naturally, and change one detail if needed.

acceptable_answers: The message is about planning a study evening.
